_comment: Expansion 3 part E.4: spells outside battle - minds and the law, disguise and illusion, the small arts (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Charms, illusions and the small arts are game/glamour.py (road ops 'mind', 'illusion' and 'art', their kinds in rules/spells.E4_KINDS); disguises are lasting spells whose 'outside' is 'disguise' (game/waymagic.after_lasting); Glibness, Nondetection and Mislead are lasting buffs ('glib', 'nondetection', 'unseen').

friends.name: Friends
friends.text: Someone within 10 feet makes a Wisdom save or warms to you for the talk that follows (Advantage on Influence). When it ends they know what you did, and like you less. Not twice on one person in a day.

enthrall.name: Enthrall
enthrall.text: A distracting string of words: everyone near who fails a Wisdom save has -10 to Perception for a minute. They see no theft and no crime, and you creep past them easily.

zone_of_truth.name: Zone of Truth
zone_of_truth.text: Someone near you makes a Charisma save or cannot lie for ten minutes: a work they gave you that hides something is shown for what it is, and an honest one is known to be honest.

geas.name: Geas
geas.text: Someone near you makes a Wisdom save or obeys you for 30 days (a year from a 7th-level slot, until ended from a 9th). They keep quiet about your crimes and see none of the new ones, tell you what they want and hide, and a guard will not arrest you.

modify_memory.name: Modify Memory
modify_memory.text: Someone near you makes a Wisdom save or forgets the last day: any crime of yours they saw and have not told yet, and the grudge they took from it.

glibness.name: Glibness
glibness.text: For an hour, when you make a Charisma check, a roll lower than 15 counts as 15: in talk, haggling, bribes and disguise. Any magic that would test your words says you speak the truth.

antipathy_sympathy.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
antipathy_sympathy.text: For 10 days a kind of creature you name is driven from you (antipathy: a band of them flees if most fail their Wisdom saves) or drawn to you entranced (sympathy: they come unaware of the danger).

awaken.name: Awaken

material.text: an agate worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

awaken.text: One of your animals wakes to a mind of its own: it speaks, takes a name, and keeps watch for you. While it is with you the camp is never caught asleep.

disguise_self.name: Disguise Self
disguise_self.text: For an hour you look like someone else: a watchman must beat your spell save DC to see through it.

seeming.name: Seeming
seeming.text: For 8 hours the whole party looks like other people: a watchman must beat your spell save DC to see through it.

minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor_illusion.text: A sound or a small image draws every eye in town away from you for a minute: -5 to their Perception, for a quick hand or a slipped watch.

silent_image.name: Silent Image
silent_image.text: A silent image draws the eyes of the town away from you for ten minutes: -5 to their Perception.

major_image.name: Major Image
major_image.text: An image with sound and smell draws the town's eyes away for ten minutes: -10 to their Perception. From a 4th-level slot it stays until you leave the town.

programmed_illusion.name: Programmed Illusion
programmed_illusion.text: An illusory camp waits for whatever comes in the night: the visitors fall on it, and the real camp, woken, catches them unaware. It lasts while you camp here.

project_image.name: Project Image
project_image.text: Your image walks into a town you know within 500 miles: you hear its news and read its board of work as if you stood there.

mislead.name: Mislead
mislead.text: You turn invisible as a double of you appears and goes on (concentration, an hour) until you attack, hurt someone or cast. In a town nobody sees what you do, until you strike someone.

hallucinatory_terrain.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
hallucinatory_terrain.text: For a day the land round the camp looks like something else: whatever hunts or prowls passes it by, unless it is clever enough to see through it.

mirage_arcane.name: Mirage Arcane
mirage_arcane.text: For 10 days the land round the camp is made to look, sound and feel like other land: whatever hunts or prowls passes it by, unless it is clever enough to see through it.

illusory_script.name: Illusory Script

material.text: a lead-based ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

illusory_script.text: For 10 days you carry a letter that shows each reader the seal they would honour: the watch waves you through the gates, and your papers impress everyone as a lord's.

magic_mouth.name: Magic Mouth

material.text: jade dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

magic_mouth.text: A mouth appears on a stone at the edge of the camp and cries out when anything comes near: it wakes you, as long as you camp here.

nystuls_magic_aura.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
nystuls_magic_aura.text: For a day a magic thing you carry shows no aura and looks like nothing much: robbers pass it over.

nondetection.name: Nondetection

material.text: diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

nondetection.text: For 8 hours no divination finds the one you touch: a foe's Detect Thoughts senses no mind there.

sequester.name: Sequester

material.text: gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

sequester.text: A thing you carry is hidden from every eye and every divination but yours: no robber, thief or watchman ever finds it. Or a fallen friend's body is held out of time: its days stop.

druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
druidcraft.text: You whisper to the spirits of nature: they tell you the weather here for the next day, and the camp's fire lights or goes out at a word.

elementalism.name: Elementalism
elementalism.text: You beckon the elements: embers light the camp's fire, a breeze dries the party a little, or a cup of clean water comes for each.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.text: Small magic tricks: the grime of a few days comes off the party's skin and clothes, and what is eaten in the next hour is warm and tasty.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.text: Your voice booms, the ground trembles, the flames flare: Advantage on Intimidation in the talk that follows.
